resources.string: Play a video in Musike: its picture shows here while the car is parked.
The video couldn\'t load here. The sound plays on.
Allow Musike to read the car\'s speed (asked on the phone): the video shows only while the car stands still.
This car doesn\'t report its speed, so the video can\'t show here. The sound plays on.
Stopped: the video shows in a few seconds.
The video shows only while the car is parked. The sound plays on.
Musike Video can\'t reach Musike. Install or update Musike on the phone.
Musike Video is ready. In Android Auto, open it among the car\'s apps: the video playing in Musike shows there while the car is parked.
